title: Unfair paywall — bring back free version

posts.author: DwarfKing
posts.body:
RPG Maker MV used to be free, and it allowed people to create games.
Now it’s paid — this is unfair!
Many people are deprived of the chance to make their own games.
Bring back the free version that was available to everyone!

posts.author: hiddenone
posts.body: RPG Maker MV has never been free, are you thinking of the demo version? MV often goes on sale, so if you want to save some money you could keep an eye out for that and then pick it up cheap.

There's a 20 day free trial but otherwise it goes on sale on Steam every month for $12.
In fact it's on sale right now until tomorrow

This might blow your mind but there are a dozen other free game engines out there. The game dev world is bigger than RPG Maker.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
XP and VXA have both been free on Steam before, for the RPG Maker Week celebration, but it was only ever as a short promotion, and it would never be something as recent as MV (XP is almost 20 years old, VXA is at least 15).
I know they're not new and shiny, but I still highly recommend them! XP routinely goes on sale for 2.50 USD, and I'd be surprised if the VXA sale price is much higher than that. That's about as close to "free" as you can reasonably expect a product to be.

posts.author: Tai_MT
posts.body:
Not to be a jerk, but...
If you can't afford a game engine to make a game...  You probably can't afford to make a game.  I mean... the assets you'd need to commission alone to do anything more than "substandard shovelware" on any engine cost more than the engine itself...

posts.author: DrBuni
posts.body: There are free game engines out there, if being free is the defining factor here. I am particularly fond of GB Studio [very easy to use] and Godot Engine [requires learning programming concepts and the Python-based GDScript language].

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
There was ages ago an RPGMaker lite that was limited to 10 events per map. That was based on ACE. However that version hasn't been available in ages. That could be what you are thinking of.
And yes, game making requires money. Always has. I still remember when you had to pay extra for sound libraries to add ability to use sound cards to your game. Those cost about $300 by the way.

posts.body:
DwarfKing said:

Unfortunately, the only free versions of RPG Maker that I am aware of were bootlegs and also the
free RPG Maker VX Ace
that I had posted back around Valentine's Day. There are regular sales on RPG Maker on Humble Bundle, Komodo Plaza, and Steam.
For the steepest discount, Humble Bundle is your best bet.
For (business) licensing purposes, Komodo Plaza is the best option.
For synchronizing between multiple devices then Steam would be the perfect.
And now that you've stated this, and I've thought about it, I need to buy another copy of RPG Maker MZ. There are a few other people who I think need RPG Maker MZ too. I am curious if Archeia knows a way how we can buy bulk discounted copies from 10 to 50 at a time?
